scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const { execSync }=require('child_process'); const copy=(src,dst)=>{ fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(dst),{recursive:true}); fs.copyFileSync(src,dst); }; copy('views/error.ejs','dist/views/error.ejs'); const pagesDir='src/admin/pages'; const distPagesDir='dist/src/admin/pages'; if (fs.existsSync(pagesDir)) { for (const name of fs.readdirSync(pagesDir)) { if (!name.endsWith('.jsx')) continue; copy(path.join(pagesDir,name), path.join(distPagesDir,name)); const base=name.slice(0,-4); const staleJs=path.join(distPagesDir, base + '.js'); if (fs.existsSync(staleJs)) fs.unlinkSync(staleJs); } } const componentsDir='src/admin/components'; const distComponentsDir='dist/src/admin/components'; if (fs.existsSync(componentsDir)) { for (const name of fs.readdirSync(componentsDir)) { if (!name.endsWith('.jsx')) continue; copy(path.join(componentsDir,name), path.join(distComponentsDir,name)); const base=name.slice(0,-4); const staleJs=path.join(distComponentsDir, base + '.js'); if (fs.existsSync(staleJs)) fs.unlinkSync(staleJs); } } const pkg=require('./package.json'); const version=String(pkg.version||'unknown'); let commit=String(process.env.APP_COMMIT||process.env.GIT_COMMIT||process.env.GIT_COMMIT_SHA||process.env.GITHUB_SHA||process.env.CF_PAGES_COMMIT_SHA||process.env.VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA||process.env.RAILWAY_GIT_COMMIT_SHA||process.env.RENDER_GIT_COMMIT||process.env.COMMIT_SHA||process.env.SOURCE_VERSION||'').trim(); try { if (!commit) commit=execSync('git rev-parse HEAD',{stdio:['ignore','pipe','ignore'],timeout:1500,windowsHide:true}).toString('utf8').trim(); } catch {} const build_time=new Date().toISOString(); const out={ version, commit: commit||null, build_time }; fs.writeFileSync(path.join('dist','build-info.json'), JSON.stringify(out,null,2), 'utf8');"
scripts.test:all: npm run lint && npm test && npm run smoke
scripts.test:runtime-regression: npm run test:all && npm run test:admin-runtime
